title: Quyosh nuri Yerga taxminan 8 daqiqa 20 soniyada yetadi

scenes.text: Yorug'lik soniyasiga qariyb 300 ming kilometr yo'l bosadi.
Quyoshdan Yergacha o'rtacha 150 million kilometr, bu yo'lga taxminan 8 daqiqa 20 soniya ketadi.

scenes.keywords: person shading eyes looking at sun

description: Quyosh Yerdan o'rtacha 150 million kilometr uzoqlikda, yorug'lik esa soniyasiga qariyb 300 ming kilometr yuradi, shuning uchun Quyosh nuri Yerga taxminan 8 daqiqa 20 soniyada yetib keladi.
source: https://www.universetoday.com/articles/how-long-does-it-take-sunlight-to-reach-the-earth (about 8 min 20 s from about 150 million km; varies about 8 min 11 s to 8 min 27 s over the orbit); https://science.nasa.gov/sun/facts/ (NASA, not openable from this session); speed of light 299,792 km/s (NIST CODATA, https://physics.nist.gov/cgi-bin/cuu/Value?c); 1 AU 149,597,870.7 km / 299,792.458 km/s = about 499 s = 8 min 19 s
